يجنوا (form I)
# يَجُنُّوا (yajunnū) /ja.d͡ʒun.nuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of جَنَّ (janna)
# يُجَنُّوا (yujannū) /ju.d͡ʒan.nuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of جَنَّ (janna) and جُنَّ (junna)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
